layers.surface: Built on planets/moons. Slot count = body size × habitability modifier. Airless bodies need a Pressure Dome first.
layers.orbital: Ring slots around any body (3–8). Shipyards, refineries, defense platforms.
layers.deep_space: Free placement. Needs a construction ship and must be inside your supply range (except Outposts, which extend it).
layers.asteroid: Hollowed asteroid slots (2–4). Cheap, hard to see, vulnerable to tractor-beam theft.

shipyard_tiers._notes: Max hull size a facility can build (see ships.json hull.size).
